response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), compared AS (SELECT client_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_region_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_client_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_region_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_region_share;
